nodes.situation: Customer calls and says he cannot locate you. The order is already delayed by 5 minutes.

choices.consequence: Customer shares correct landmark and becomes cooperative.
choices.reflection: Proactively contacting the customer helps resolve ambiguity quickly and improves customer trust.

choices.consequence: Customer becomes frustrated and contacts support.
choices.reflection: Avoiding communication may save time initially but often increases customer dissatisfaction and escalations.

nodes.situation: Customer gives the correct location and is waiting outside.

choices.text: Deliver order politely and apologize for delay
choices.reflection: Taking ownership and communicating respectfully often improves customer experience even when delays occur.

choices.consequence: Customer receives order but experience feels cold.
choices.reflection: Task completion is important, but customer interactions also influence overall service quality.

nodes.situation: Customer is angry because delivery was marked unavailable.

choices.consequence: Customer calms down but remains slightly unhappy.
choices.reflection: Recovering from mistakes quickly can reduce negative impact and rebuild trust.
Escalating conflict usually damages customer relationships and business outcomes.

outcomes.title: Positive Customer Experience
outcomes.description: Customer received order successfully and appreciated your communication.

outcomes.title: Issue Resolved
outcomes.description: Order completed but customer experience could be improved.

outcomes.title: Customer Complaint
outcomes.description: Customer escalated the issue to support.
